title: The Base Excess on a ShieldCare Claim by the Peril Reported
content:
The base excess on a claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is a multiple of the plan's
deductible, and the multiple turns on the peril reported and on what the claim was settled at.

| What the claim shows | Multiple of the plan's deductible | The base excess |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the peril reported is theft, and the amount settled on the claim is above 10 times the plan's deductible | 2 | the plan's deductible taken twice |
| the peril reported is theft, and the amount settled is no more than 10 times that deductible | 1.5 | the plan's deductible and a half |
| every other claim | 1 | the plan's deductible |

### Both sides of the comparison

The comparison is with 10 times the plan's deductible. On a plan whose deductible is 99.00, that
figure is 990.00: an amount settled of 990.01 is above it and carries the multiple of 2, while an
amount settled of exactly 990.00 is not above it and carries the multiple of 1.5. On any peril other
than theft the multiple is 1, whatever the amount settled.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

| Plan's deductible | Peril reported | Amount settled | Base excess |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 99.00 | theft | 1400.00 | 198.00 |
| 99.00 | theft | 700.00 | 148.50 |
| 99.00 | liquid ingress | 1400.00 | 99.00 |
| 149.00 | theft | 1100.00 | 223.50 |
